en: Meet a wild Pokémon, and you chuck a Quick Ball straight off!
And if catching it drags on and on, that's the time for a Timer Ball!
text: Întâlnești un Pokémon sălbatic și arunci imediat un Ball Rapid!
Iar dacă prinderea se tot lungește, e momentul pentru un Ball Cronometru!

en: That boy over there has no Pokémon of his own.
He says he's training his imagination!
text: Băiatul de acolo n-are niciun Pokémon al lui.

en: If only there were two of everything, I could challenge my papa!
text: Dacă ar fi câte două din toate, l-aș putea provoca pe tati!

en: B1F: Food and Produce. 1F: Trainers' Zone. 2F: Battle Collection. 3F: TM Corner. 4F: Poké Dolls and Goods. 5F: Rooftop Plaza.
